channel.title: The Augusta Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Augusta Press (theaugustapress.com)

item.title: Latin America Amateur Championship will return to Peru
item.description: The Latin America Amateur Championship (LAAC) will return Jan. 15–18, with a field of 108 players representing 29 countries and territories.

item.title: Unmasked: Homeless man jailed in killing of Grovetown father outside Helms College
item.description: An Augusta man has been arrested and charged months after a Grovetown father was fatally stabbed while waiting outside Helms College.

item.title: Georgia Senate bans local gun storage laws with first bill passed in 2026
item.description: The Georgia Senate voted along party lines Tuesday to ban cities from requiring gun owners to lock up their guns in cars, the first bill approved in this year’s legislative session.

item.title: Columbia County school board approves 2026 leadership roles, recognizes Greenbrier girls flag football
item.description: The Columbia County Board of Education approved leadership roles, a security camera contract and honored Greenbrier girls flag football team.

item.title: Sheriff Whittle looks back on deadly stop & debunks ATF-waiting narrative
item.description: Columbia County Sheriff Clay Whittle has defended his agency's actions in the deadly traffic stop last April, saying his office was legally required to immediately serve a court-ordered temporary protective order on James Blake Montgomery while rejecting claims his team was debating whether to wait on the ATF.

item.title: Augusta weighs $2M fast track for Broad as nine parks face sale
item.description: Augusta commissioners are considering a $2 million incentive to accelerate construction of the Broad Street improvements project.

item.title: Long-withheld NDA agreement for Appling data center property shows no trade secrets
item.description: The NDA between Trammell Crow Co. and Columbia County was released Monday after months of attempts to retrieve the document via ORR.

item.title: Augusta senator releases statement on gun bill addendum
item.description: Senate Minority Leader Harold Jones II, D-Augusta, released a statement Tuesday on a proposed Senate amendment he said restricts local governments’ ability to regulate the storage of firearms.

item.title: Martinez teen accused of molesting girl for years
item.description: A Martinez teen was charged Monday with aggravated child molestation, accused of sex acts on a girl that started when he was 12 and the girl was 8.

item.title: Three more suspects charged in 2023 murder in Aiken County
item.description: Three more people have been arrested or charged in connection with the 2023 shooting death of 20-year-old Jatavious Harris of Batesburg, according to Aiken County authorities.
